note: USACE (Fort Worth District) primitive park on the shore of Lake Whitney just south of Morgan. 21 camp/picnic sites with ground cookers, no hookups; two vault-toilet restrooms, water faucets, two boat ramps. Drive-in sites strung along the shoreline road. First-come, first-served (not on recreation.gov). --Claude
